results.snippet:
The Kaduna–Kano railway is a key component of the Federal Government’s efforts to expand Nigeria’s rail network and improve connectivity between major commercial centres in the North-West.

When completed and operational, the corridor is expected to provide an alternative to road travel, improve passenger movement and support economic activities along the route.
